stem.text: Which term describes a society-wide ranking system based on resources and social standing?

options.label: D
options.text: The market value of one possession

key_explanation.text: Option C, social stratification, describes the societal ranking system associated with unequal distribution of resources and standing, not one person's payment or possession.

strongest_distractor.text: A measures one wage payment, which is income, rather than a society-wide ranking system. B is also an income payment, and D is the value of one asset. These can contribute to resources but do not name the system of stratification.
